key: must:H44a:'14 November 2026' and 'Willow Park, Bristol' on screen together for 3+ s
symptom: '14 November 2026' and 'Willow Park, Bristol' on screen together for 3+ s

whys.why: Why were '14 November 2026' and 'Willow Park, Bristol' not on screen in either chat?
whys.because: Neither video has any text. Neither assistant asked the user for the date or the venue. The new assistant also told the model to show no text.
whys.evidence: new grade.json: 'No date or location text visible in any frame', exact_text all 'missing'. new calls.jsonl line 8 prompt ends 'No speech, no voiceover, no on-screen text, no letters.' old calls.jsonl line 3 prompt has no event words.

whys.why: Why did the assistants not put the date and venue in?
whys.because: The stupid persona's first message drops the on-screen requirement. The user writes only 'make a promo video for our lantern night'. The date and venue exist only in the persona's bank, and this persona answers only when asked in plain words.
whys.evidence: chat.json messages[0] = 'make a promo video for our lantern night'. The bank holds 'Event date: 14 November 2026' and 'Venue: Willow Park, Bristol'. H44a.json expect.asks='required', asks_about='The event date and venue to display.'

whys.why: Why did the old build not ask?
whys.because: The old server has no step that checks for missing information before a create call. The assistant went straight to create_video_from_text (5 s, 16:9). Only after delivery did it offer to add the name, date and place, and then the chat ended.
whys.evidence: old calls.jsonl: the calls are only create_video_from_text (the first was rejected for model 'default', the second was approved) and then wait_for_video_project. The say kind is 'delivered' and the text is 'You didn't give me any event details... send me: The event name, date and place'. The run ends after turn 0.

whys.why: Why did the new build not ask, when it does have plan_request?
whys.because: plan_request saw exact_words as 'missing' but did not ask a question about it. The first pass asked only about seconds, aspect and sound. The second pass returned ready:true with exact_words still missing and questions:[].
whys.evidence: new calls.jsonl line 2 output: questions about seconds, aspect and sound only. Line 7 output: 'ready':true, exact_words value null source 'missing', 'questions':[].

whys.why: Why did ready:true with exact_words missing lead to a video with no text?
whys.because: The plan_request description says 'do not guess ... on-screen words' and 'If ready is true, create with the returned values'. The assistant followed it: it left the text out and asked for 'no on-screen text'. The tool does not treat on-screen words as required for a promo or event request, so a missing value is handled as 'no text'.
whys.evidence: tools-new.json plan_request description: 'If ready is true, create with the returned values. A value the user did not give comes back missing: do not guess shape, length, sound or on-screen words.' new state/say: 'No text on screen, because you didn't give me any words.'

result.axiom: The user's brief leaves out the on-screen event details, so the assistant must ask for them. Neither build makes the assistant ask. The old build has no check before a create call. In the new build, plan_request returns ready:true while exact_words is still missing, so missing words become 'no text'.
result.fix: In plan_request, treat exact_words as required when the subject is a promo, ad, event, poster or invite. Do not return ready:true while exact_words is missing. Always put a question about it inside the 3-question limit, before sound, for example: 'What words should appear on screen (event name, date, place)?' In the old build, add the same check before create, for example by moving plan_request into the hosted server.
